scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
I worked myself to death trying to fulfill Lord Kaho's ridiculous expectations for a headgear!
Now that I've finally found the formula for the perfect headgear, I'm willing to share my time and talents.
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
为了满足卡浩大人对头饰那些离谱的要求，我差点累死！
如今总算找到了制作完美头饰的配方，我也愿意花时间发挥手艺，帮你做一份。

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
You need the following to get the Kaho horns:
3x ^0055FFEmperium^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
要得到卡浩之角，你需要这些材料：
3x ^0055FF华丽金属^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
Oh yeah...
I also forgot to mention these...
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
哦对了...
我还忘了提这些...

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
We're not done yet, sweetie...
I'm a big fan of dolls, so you need to bring me these cuties!
1x ^0055FF{0}^000000
1x ^0055FF{1}^000000
1x ^0055FF{2}^000000
1x ^0055FF{3}^000000
1x ^0055FF{4}^000000
1x ^0055FF{5}^000000
1x ^0055FF{6}^000000
1x ^0055FF{7}^000000

[Lord Kaho's Servant]
Finally, I've worked hard to make these horns for my master with all the items mentioned above...
Please include ^0055FF5 million Zeny^000000 for my efforts.
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
最后，我可是费了好大的劲，才用上面那些材料为主人做出这对角...
还得支付^0055FF500万 Zeny^000000作为我的辛苦费。

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
Are you ready for me to make this special item?
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
你准备好让我制作这件特殊物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
What I had to go through was more unfathomable...
If you succeed in getting these items, you will have incredible strength!
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
我当初吃的苦才叫离谱...
不过，集齐这些东西，你就能获得惊人的力量！

scripts.text:
[Lord Kaho's Servant]
I can't afford to make this if you don't bring all materials needed. Please understand this is to benefit heroes such as yourself!
scripts.translation:
[卡浩大人的仆从]
材料不齐，我可没办法给你做。要知道，这可是为了造福像你这样的英雄！

scripts.text: I can't afford to make this if you don't bring all materials needed. Please understand this is to benefit heroes such as yourself!
scripts.translation: 材料不齐，我可没办法给你做。要知道，这可是为了造福像你这样的英雄！

scripts.text:
Wow! You are brave indeed!
Enjoy being God of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
哇！你真是勇敢！
享受在米德加尔特成为神的感觉吧！
